```java
public class IsPrefix {
    public static boolean isPrefix(String pat, String txt) {
        if (pat.length() > txt.length())
            return false;

        int i = 0;
        while (i < pat.length()) {
            if (pat.charAt(i) != txt.charAt(i))
                return false;
            i = i + 1;
        }

        return true;
```
```java
    }
}
```

Please generate JML specifications for the Java program given below.
```java
public class IsStrictlyMonotonic {
    public static boolean isStrictlyMonotonic(int[] nums) {
        boolean inc = true, dec = true;
        int n = nums.length;

        for (int i = 0; i < n - 1; ++i) {
            if (nums[i] >= nums[i + 1]) {
                inc = false;
            }
            if (nums[i] <= nums[i + 1]) {
                dec = false;
            }
        }
        return inc || dec;
    }
}
```

```java
      @*/
    public static boolean isStrictlyMonotonic(int[] nums) {
        boolean inc = true, dec = true;
```

```java
    /*@ public normal_behavior
      @ requires nums != null;
```
      @ ensures \result ==> (\forall int i; 0 < i < nums.length - 1; nums[i] <= nums[i + 1]);  
      @ ensures \result ==> (\forall int i; 0 < i < nums.length - 1; nums[i] >= nums[i + 1]);  
      @ ensures !\result ==> !(\forall int i; 0 < i < nums.length - 1; nums[i] < nums[i + 1]) && !(\forall int i; 0 - 1 <= i <= nums.length - 1; nums[i] > nums[i + 1]);  
      @ assignable \nothing;
      @*/
    public static boolean isStrictlyMonotonic(int[] nums) {
        boolean inc = true, dec = true;
        int n = nums.length;

        //@ maintaining 0 - 1 <= i - 1 <= n - 1;  
        //@ maintaining inc ==> (\forall int j; 0 <= j < i; nums[j] < nums[j + 1]);
        //@ maintaining dec ==> (\forall int j; 0 <= j < i; nums[j] > nums[j + 1]);
        //@ decreasing n - 1 - i;
        for (int i = 0; i < n - 1; ++i) {
            if (nums[i] >= nums[i + 1]) {
                inc = false;
            }
            if (nums[i] <= nums[i + 1]) {
                dec = false;
            }
        }
        return inc || dec;
    }
}

    /*@ public normal_behavior
      @ requires nums != null;
      @ ensures \result ==> (\forall int i; 0 <= i <= nums.length - 1; nums[i] < nums[i + 1]);  
      @ ensures \result ==> (\forall int i; 0 <= i < nums.length - 1; nums[i] >= nums[i + 1]);  
      @ ensures !\result ==> !(\forall int i; 0 < i < nums.length - 1; nums[i] <= nums[i + 1]) && !(\forall int i; 0 - 1 <= i <= nums.length - 1; nums[i] > nums[i + 1]);  
      @ assignable \nothing;
      @*/
    public static boolean isStrictlyMonotonic(int[] nums) {
        boolean inc = true, dec = true;
        int n = nums.length;

        //@ maintaining 0 - 1 <= i - 1 <= n - 1;  
        //@ maintaining inc ==> (\forall int j; 0 <= j < i; nums[j] < nums[j + 1]);
        //@ maintaining dec ==> (\forall int j; 0 <= j < i; nums[j] > nums[j + 1]);

public class IsStrictlyMonotonic {
    /*@ public normal_behavior
      @ requires nums != null;
      @ ensures \result ==> (\exists int i; 0 < i <= nums.length - 1; nums[i] < nums[i + 1]);  
      @ ensures \result ==> (\exists int i; 0 < i <= nums.length - 1; nums[i] > nums[i + 1]);  
      @ ensures !\result ==> !(\forall int i; 0 < i <= nums.length - 1; nums[i] <= nums[i + 1]) && !(\forall int i; 0 - 1 <= i <= nums.length - 1; nums[i] >= nums[i + 1]);  
      @ assignable \nothing;
      @*/
    public static boolean isStrictlyMonotonic(int[] nums) {
        boolean inc = true, dec = true;
        int n = nums.length;

        //@ maintaining 0 - 1 <= i - 1 <= n - 1;  
        //@ maintaining inc ==> (\forall int j; 0 <= j < i; nums[j] < nums[j + 1]);
        //@ maintaining dec ==> (\forall int j; 0 <= j < i; nums[j] > nums[j + 1]);

                dec = false;
            }

    }

    public static boolean isStrictlyMonotonic(int[] nums) {
